name: Finite Parent-Rank Lower Bound for Cartesian Powers
statement: For every nonempty proper maximum-generated class $C$ and every $k\ge1$, $h(C^k)\ge h(C)+(k-1)\operatorname{VC}(C)$.
proof: Choose a positioned cube of dimension $\operatorname{VC}(C)$ in each of the first $k-1$ factors. Fully reduce those cube coordinates and fix all remaining visible coordinates in those factors. Any rank-$h(C^k)$ parent of $C^k$ then yields a parent of the last copy of $C$ whose rank is lower by $(k-1)\operatorname{VC}(C)$. Its rank is at least $h(C)$, giving the inequality.
comments: A fixed one-copy excess in $h(C)$ does not by itself imply an asymptotic excess in $\gamma(C)$.
